**Location:** Andromeda / Heleus Cluster / Hefena System /  **Third planet**

## Description

**Dovar**'s gravity is abnormally light for a world of its size. This is certainly an effect of mass fields generated by the Scourge; Dovar should be further observed as it escapes Scourge tendrils.
